description:
About the role

The Integrated Marketing Manager, Global Programs turns GTM campaign strategy into targeted programs for priority industries, executive audiences, and enterprise accounts. You’ll own a defined portfolio of vertical, executive, and threat intelligence programs that build credibility, engage buying committees, and generate pipeline.

Working alongside Campaign Managers and regional teams, you’ll lead program planning, execution, and measurement. You’ll build repeatable programs that regions can adapt to their markets and directly execute select executive engagements.

This role combines audience-focused program development with hands-on demand generation, turning campaign strategy into engagement, meetings, and pipeline. Initial priorities include one or two verticals, a defined executive program, and threat intelligence marketing. You’ll partner with Digital, Field, Customer, and Channel Marketing to deliver coordinated programs with clear responsibilities, milestones, and KPIs.

What you’ll do

Build targeted global programs

  • Develop annual and quarterly program plans aligned with agreed campaign priorities, target-account needs, and pipeline goals.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Content to develop vertical and executive messaging that connects business challenges with customer stories, competitive differentiation, and threat research.
  • Lead marketing programs for priority Fortune 1000 accounts in partnership with Sales and Field Marketing, aligning tailored messaging, executive engagement, and coordinated outreach to deepen buying committee engagement and generate pipeline.
  • Create repeatable program kits with audience definitions, content, event formats, outreach cadences, and sales follow-up guidance.
  • Partner with Alliances and Channel Marketing to adapt programs for partner audiences and develop co-marketing plans.

Own threat intelligence marketing

  • Partner with threat researchers, Product Marketing, and Campaign Managers to identify priority research for marketing activation and develop coordinated program plans.
  • Turn research into reports, briefings, webinars, and sales plays, partnering with Content on development and publishing and Communications on media and analyst engagement.
  • Coordinate timely marketing responses to major threats, equipping Sales and regional teams with relevant content and outreach.
  • Grow and engage a subscriber community through recurring threat intelligence content and briefings.

Execute strategic executive engagements

  • Own select CISO dinners, roundtables, private briefings, and Fortune 1000 engagements, including program design, speakers, invitations, and follow-up.
  • Partner with Field Marketing, Sales, and SDR leaders to drive target-account participation, secure meetings, and establish clear next steps.
  • Develop playbooks and equip regional teams to deliver additional executive programs.

Measure and improve performance

  • Define program KPIs and track sourced and influenced pipeline, target-account engagement, executive meetings, regional adoption, and threat intelligence reach and engagement.
  • Use performance data and feedback from Sales and regional teams to recommend which programs to improve, scale, or retire.
  • Coordinate targeting and timing with Campaign Managers, Field Marketing, and Marketing Operations to maintain a consistent account experience.

What you bring

  • 5+ years in B2B integrated, demand generation, field, industry, or audience marketing, ideally in cybersecurity or enterprise software.
  • A track record of building targeted programs that engage priority accounts and generate pipeline.
  • Experience leading programs across countries or regions, coordinating stakeholders, timelines, and local execution.
  • Experience translating technical research or threat intelligence into compelling content and marketing programs.
  • Strong messaging and writing skills, with the ability to connect technical topics to industry challenges and executive priorities.
  • Experience building repeatable programs for regional teams and directly executing high-touch executive engagements.
  • Strong cross-functional project management skills and experience partnering with Sales, Product Marketing, Content, and Field Marketing.
  • Comfort with account-based marketing, target-account planning, and pipeline measurement.

Preferred: Experience marketing to CISOs; experience in financial services, healthcare, or other regulated industries; partner co-marketing experience.

Travel required for select events and executive programs.

 

#LI-VY1

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Base salary range:
$107,100—$154,000 USD

A note on AI in our process: 
Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.

Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
